title: Choose a message
summary: Bash: Choose a message. Try score=3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: [[ ... ]] tests a rule. -ge means greater than or equal for whole numbers.

blocks.text: Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.

blocks.title: Choose a message
blocks.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
score=8
if [[ "$score" -ge 5 ]]; then
 printf 'Pass\n'
else
 printf 'Try again\n'
fi

blocks.text: The -ge test succeeds for 8. Bash runs the then commands.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use spaces inside [[ and ]] and finish the block with fi.
